calls.query:
SELECT 
    CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS refund_date, 
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count, 
    SUM(debit)/100.0 AS total_refund_amount_rs
FROM rp 
WHERE type = 'refund'
GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE)
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, total_refund_amount_rs DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    CAST(settled_at AS DATE) AS settled_date, 
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count, 
    SUM(debit)/100.0 AS total_refund_amount_rs
FROM rp 
WHERE type = 'refund'
GROUP BY CAST(settled_at AS DATE)
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    CAST(refund_date AS DATE) AS order_refund_date, 
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count, 
    SUM(refund_amount)/100.0 AS total_refund_rs
FROM orders 
WHERE refund_amount > 0
GROUP BY CAST(refund_date AS DATE)
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
